top_signals.title: Dubai Seals Deal to Form $159 Billion Islamic Banking Giant
top_signals.summary: Dubai Islamic Bank PJSC said it’s buying Emirates Islamic Bank PJSC in an all-stock deal that will create one of the world’s largest listed Islamic-banking groups, with combined assets of about $159 billion.

top_signals.title: Adani Firms Plan Public Bond Sale to Raise at Least $220 Million
top_signals.summary: Two companies controlled by Indian billionaire Gautam Adani are looking to sell public bonds to raise at least 20 billion rupees ($220 million), according to people familiar with the matter, which would boost the nation’s subdued domestic public debt market.
